Harpreet Agarwal
Senior DevOps Engineer | Noida, Uttar Pradesh
harpreet.agarwal50@example.com | +91 9160538438

Experienced DevOps and SRE professional with a strong focus on infrastructure automation, observability, and reliable CI/CD delivery. Proven track record implementing Terraform-driven infrastructure, container orchestration, and scalable monitoring solutions to reduce incidents and improve deployment velocity. Seeking to continue driving platform reliability and developer productivity; notice period: 30 days.

Experience

Senior DevOps Engineer
- Led Terraform-based provisioning of multi-account AWS landing zones and automated S3 lifecycle and encryption policies, reducing manual setup time by 70% and ensuring compliance across 40+ projects.
- Implemented cluster-level k8s configuration and GitOps workflows integrating k8s manifests with GitHub Actions, achieving 30% faster application rollouts and predictable deployment health.
- Built Grafana dashboards and CloudWatch metric pipelines for core services, improving alert precision and reducing mean time to detect by 45%.
- Automated CI/CD pipelines and SQS-backed async processing tests to validate end-to-end deployments, decreasing post-deploy incidents by 25%.

Ledgerly — Apr 2021 - Aug 2021
Cloud Engineer (remote)
- Designed Terraform modules for repeatable VPC, ECS and S3 configurations used across environments, accelerating test environment creation from days to hours.
- Created CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions to run linting, integration tests and blue/green deployments, increasing deployment frequency while maintaining stability.
- Integrated CloudWatch metrics and Grafana visualizations for transactional workflows and SQS queue monitoring, enabling capacity tuning and lowering message processing lag by 40%.
- Coordinated with engineering teams via Jira to standardize release practices and rollback playbooks, reducing failed release recovery time.

Razorpay — Aug 2019 - Mar 2021
Site Reliability Engineer (on-site)

- Automated infrastructure provisioning with Terraform and maintained S3-backed backups and lifecycle rules for retention and compliance.
- Instrumented CloudWatch-based alerting and Grafana dashboards for latency and error metrics; introduced runbooks and playbooks that cut incident resolution time by 35%.
- Optimized CI/CD integration with Git and GitHub Actions pipelines for rollout safety; collaborated through Jira to track postmortems and continuous improvements.

NimbusSoft — Sep 2017 - Jul 2019
DevOps Engineer (on-site)
- Administered Linux servers and migrated several monolith services to containerized deployments on k8s, improving deploy consistency and resource utilization.
- Implemented AWS S3 storage strategies and CloudWatch monitoring for service health and log aggregation.
- Built Grafana dashboards for system metrics and set up alerts to pro-actively detect service degradation, reducing customer-facing incidents.
- Used Git for source control and integrated CI/CD triggers to automate test and deployment steps, streamlining developer workflows.

Projects
- Internal k8s GitOps Starter: Developed reusable k8s manifest templates and GitHub Actions workflows to bootstrap new microservices with standard observability and CI/CD.
- S3 Cost Optimization Script: Automated identification of infrequently accessed S3 objects and applied lifecycle policies, cutting storage costs for a project by ~28%.
